newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian politicians appeal for calm in Tirana.
newsitem.headline: Albanian politicians appeal for calm in Tirana.

text.p: Albanian political parties appealed for calm in Tirana on Wednesday as rebels opposed to President Sali Berisha strengthened their grip in the south of their country.

Albanian state television interrupted its normal programming to broadcast the appeal, in which party officials called on their supporters to keep cool heads and urged authorities to disarm citizens who have looted weapons.
The statement also urged the international media to play its part in defusing tension and urged Albanian radio and television to give a truthful account of events in Tirana.

"We call on the people of the capital to keep cool heads, to protect their city from any kind of provocation and rumour," said the statement read on behalf of the Tirana branches of Albania's main political parties by Albert Brojka, the mayor of Tirana.
"All your brothers should contribute towards keeping the peace, to protect public and private property and the life of each citizen," he said.

Tension rose in Tirana on Wednesday, but the capital has so far been spared the widespread unrest that has seen most of the south of the country fall into the hands of armed citizens in the last few days.
